(Ref: https://github.com/BerriAI/litellm/pull/49485)

workarounds.symptom: [Bug]: Budget refusal on /a2a/{agent} is an OpenAI error with string code "422", not a JSON-RPC error

A2A clients that call an agent through the proxy now get a proper JSON-RPC error when the proxy refuses the call (over budget, bad key, agent not granted), so strict clients like the Rust a2a-rs crate can read the reason instead of failing to decode the body. The HTTP status co... (Ref: https://github.com/BerriAI/litellm/pull/49476)

workarounds.symptom: [Bug]: Team-member budget exhaustion still blocks model discovery and self-service info routes in 1.104.4 (follow-up to #27923)
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix(proxy): preserve discovery after budget exhaustion (#48809). Target files: litellm/proxy/auth/auth_checks.py, litellm/proxy/auth/user_api_key_auth.py, tests/unit/proxy/auth/test_auth_checks_object_access_and_lookup.py. An exhausted team-member budget blocks model discovery and the caller's key/user info. An exhausted key budget also blocks discovery. Centralize route, MCP-discovery, and zero-cost model exemptions in the existing request-budget helper. Virtual-key auth, JWT auth, and common checks delegate to it. Paid in... (Ref: https://github.com/BerriAI/litellm/pull/49463)

workarounds.symptom: OpenAI pass-through `POST /v1/decisions` is logged with $0 spend and no token usage
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix(proxy): price OpenAI pass-through /v1/decisions calls like native Decisions. Target files: litellm/proxy/_types.py, litellm/proxy/pass_through_endpoints/llm_provider_handlers/openai_passthrough_logging_handler.py, litellm/proxy/pass_through_endpoints/success_handler.py. Calls to OpenAI's Decisions API through the `/openai` pass-through route now show up in spend logs with real token counts and cost. Before this, they reached OpenAI and came back fine but were logged at $0 with no tokens, so key and team budgets never mo... (Ref: https://github.com/BerriAI/litellm/pull/49392)

workarounds.symptom: [Bug]: `/v1/images/generations` requests refused by the router never reach failure callbacks (chat ones do)
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix(proxy): log router-refused image generation requests. Target files: litellm/router.py, tests/unit/proxy/image_endpoints/test_endpoints.py. Image requests rejected by the router now reach failure logging, so deployment limits no longer leave an observability gap (Ref: https://github.com/BerriAI/litellm/pull/49349)

workarounds.symptom: [Bug]: jev classifier sends the current message and system prompt untrimmed, so the decision deployment returns 422 and routing falls back to the heuristic scorer
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix(router): budget classifier input by provider limits. Target files: litellm/decisions/call.py, litellm/integrations/otel/routing.py, litellm/llms/azure_ai/decisions/transformation.py. Large user or system messages can exceed a decision classifier's input limit, so successful chat requests silently use heuristic routing. This change budgets the complete classifier request using provider limits and effective context settings, then records trimming and fallback reasons. The downstream model still receives the full conversation (Ref: https://github.com/BerriAI/litellm/pull/49306)

workarounds.symptom: [Bug]: Cannot edit a model with configured access windows
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix(proxy): preserve access windows when editing models. Target files: litellm/proxy/management_endpoints/model_management_endpoints.py, tests/unit/proxy/management_endpoints/test_model_management_endpoints.py. Models with saved access windows can now be edited without removing their time restrictions. Saved windows remain intact unless the administrator explicitly replaces or clears them. (Ref: https://github.com/BerriAI/litellm/pull/49316)

workarounds.symptom: [Bug]: SGLang context overflow wording maps to plain BadRequestError
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix(exceptions): classify SGLang context window overflow. Target files: litellm/litellm_core_utils/exception_mapping_utils.py, tests/unit/litellm_core_utils/test_exception_mapping_utils.py. SGLang's "requested token count exceeds the model's maximum context length" 400 now raises `ContextWindowExceededError` instead of a plain `BadRequestError`. The visible win is that `context_window_fallbacks` finally fire for SGLang deployments, while unrelated 400s stay `BadRequestError` (Ref: https://github.com/BerriAI/litellm/pull/48837)

workarounds.symptom: [Bug]: Context window errors reported inside a stream skip fallbacks (Responses API response.failed)
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix(router): recover streamed context window errors before output. Target files: litellm/responses/streaming_iterator.py, litellm/router.py, tests/integration/providers/test_bedrock_mantle_context_overflow_fallbacks_wire.py. Streaming context-window errors can return to the client without trying a configured fallback. This change lets the router recover before output reaches the client and preserves context-specific fallback selection (Ref: https://github.com/BerriAI/litellm/pull/49293)

workarounds.symptom: [Feature]: record which provider served an OpenRouter request, next to its reported cost
workarounds.workaround: Fix: feat(openrouter): record upstream provider in logging payload and spend logs. Target files: litellm/litellm_core_utils/streaming_chunk_builder_utils.py, litellm/litellm_core_utils/streaming_handler.py, litellm/llms/openrouter/chat/transformation.py. OpenRouter tells us which upstream provider actually served each request, but LiteLLM was throwing that away, so two identical calls that cost different amounts looked the same in logs and spend. This PR keeps OpenRouter's top-level `provider` field as `upstream_provider` in the... (Ref: https://github.com/BerriAI/litellm/pull/49287)

workarounds.symptom: [Bug]: key router_settings.fallbacks are ignored on /v1/images/generations (chat completions honors them)
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix(proxy): apply key and team router_settings to /v1/images/generations. Target files: litellm/proxy/common_request_processing.py, litellm/proxy/image_endpoints/endpoints.py, tests/integration/routing/test_key_router_settings_image_generation.py. Keys and teams with `router_settings` (fallbacks, retries, timeouts, model group aliases) now get those settings on `/v1/images/generations`, the same way they already do on chat completions and image edits. Before this PR an image generation request with a failing primary model f... (Ref: https://github.com/BerriAI/litellm/pull/49286)

workarounds.symptom: [Bug]: native CLI login consent page lists teams in database order and preselects the first one
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix(sso): keep CLI SSO and Claude Code gateway team lists in the user record's order. Target files: litellm/proxy/auth/handle_jwt.py, litellm/proxy/management_endpoints/internal_user_endpoints.py, litellm/proxy/management_endpoints/scim/scim_v2.py. For a developer on several teams, the proxy listed their teams in Postgres's row order, which moves on every team write. So `lite login`'s `skip`, the `--pkce` preselect, and the gateway's team dropdown (#49001) changed between sign-ins (Ref: https://github.com/BerriAI/litellm/pull/49033)

workarounds.symptom: [Bug]: session.update instructions silently ignored for vertex_ai/gemini-live — need gemini_live_defer_setup documented + confirmed behavior and turn_detection not working like in sdk
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix(realtime)!: send the Gemini Live setup at the first content so session.update settings apply. Target files: litellm/constants.py, litellm/litellm_core_utils/realtime_streaming.py, litellm/llms/base_llm/realtime/transformation.py. Gemini and Vertex Live sessions on `/v1/realtime` dropped the client's `session.update`, since the proxy sent its own audio setup at connect and Gemini takes only one. Text clients got audio, and instructions and tools never reached the model (Ref: https://github.com/BerriAI/litellm/pull/39864)

workarounds.symptom: [Bug]: Claude models on Vertex AI fail at batch creation (404 batchPredictionJobs) — OpenAI batch translation doesn't cover Anthropic's native schema
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix(vertex_ai): batch Claude models in Anthropic's native row shape. Target files: litellm/llms/vertex_ai/batches/handler.py, litellm/llms/vertex_ai/batches/transformation.py, litellm/llms/vertex_ai/files/transformation.py. Claude on Vertex AI now runs through LiteLLM's managed batch route, which used to 404 at create. Lines go to Vertex as Anthropic Messages rows and come back as priced OpenAI batch rows (Ref: https://github.com/BerriAI/litellm/pull/45715)

workarounds.symptom: websearch_interception chat-completions agentic follow-up misroutes model: 'LLM Provider NOT provided ... model=mantle/...'
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix(websearch)!: keep the provider prefix on the agentic follow-up model. Target files: litellm/integrations/websearch_interception/handler.py, litellm/litellm_core_utils/chat_completion_agentic_loop.py, litellm/litellm_core_utils/core_helpers.py. Web search follow-ups now keep the caller's full model, so Bedrock Mantle and OpenRouter org models stop failing or reaching the wrong provider (Ref: https://github.com/BerriAI/litellm/pull/38885)

workarounds.symptom: [Bug] Multiple system messages sent to non-OpenAI providers when using Responses API with developer role messages
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix(llms): move later developer messages for models declared system-first. Target files: litellm/constants.py, litellm/llms/anthropic/chat/transformation.py, litellm/llms/anthropic/messages/native/transformation.py. Codex and other Responses API clients send a developer item after the first input item. LiteLLM turns it into a `system` message in place, and system-first chat templates such as Qwen3.5 and Qwen3.8 answer 400 `System message must be at the beginning` (Ref: https://github.com/BerriAI/litellm/pull/48897)

workarounds.symptom: [Bug]: Gemini context caching with custom api_base uses invalid cache URL and auth header
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix(vertex_ai): build the cachedContents collection URL under a custom api_base. Target files: litellm/llms/vertex_ai/context_caching/vertex_ai_context_caching.py, litellm/llms/vertex_ai/vertex_llm_base.py, litellm/types/llms/vertex_ai.py. Gemini and Vertex AI context caching failed behind a custom `api_base`, because Google rejects the `models/<model>:cachedContents` URL the proxy built (Ref: https://github.com/BerriAI/litellm/pull/44783)

workarounds.symptom: [Bug]: Editing a reusable credential can overwrite real secrets with masked placeholders
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix(credentials): keep the stored secret when PATCH echoes its masked read-back. Target files: litellm/litellm_core_utils/litellm_logging.py, litellm/proxy/credential_endpoints/endpoints.py, tests/unit/proxy/credential_endpoints/test_endpoints.py. Reading a credential back from the API gives you its secrets masked, like `sk****EA`. Sending that object back with PATCH to edit another field saved the mask as the key, breaking every model on it. The Admin UI's Edit Credential dialog did the same to Vertex credentials (Ref: https://github.com/BerriAI/litellm/pull/48950)

workarounds.symptom: Bedrock audio transcription hardcodes a system message in the Rust codec, breaking Voxtral (400 'Found system messages at indexes [0] and audio chunks')
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix(bedrock): omit system prompt from audio transcription and report its token usage. Target files: litellm-rust/crates/llms-types/src/formats/audio_transcription/response.rs, litellm-rust/crates/llms/src/bedrock/audio_transcription/mod.rs, litellm/cost_calculator.py. Bedrock Voxtral transcription through `/v1/audio/transcriptions` always failed with a 400, because LiteLLM sent a system prompt that Voxtral on Bedrock refuses next to audio. This PR drops that prompt (Ref: https://github.com/BerriAI/litellm/pull/41565)

workarounds.symptom: [Feature]: Support Ollama decision models through the Decisions API
workarounds.workaround: Fix: feat(decisions): support Ollama decision models. Target files: litellm/__init__.py, litellm/_lazy_imports_registry.py, litellm/llms/ollama/decisions/transformation.py. Ollama decision models now work through both LiteLLM Decisions endpoints and the Python SDK without the hosted-vLLM workaround. Both Ollama prefixes keep their own provider identity in spend logs and share the existing request and response translation (Ref: https://github.com/BerriAI/litellm/pull/48871)

workarounds.symptom: [Bug]: aimage_edit() turns a missing image into [None] instead of [], crashing Black Forest Labs image edit with an uncaught ValueError
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix(images): normalize absent images in async edits. Target files: litellm/images/main.py, tests/unit/images/test_image_edit.py. BFL image edits without an image now return HTTP 400 with “No image provided” instead of HTTP 500. Async edits use the same absent-image handling as sync edits, with a regression test for both null and empty-list input (Ref: https://github.com/BerriAI/litellm/pull/48872)

workarounds.symptom: [Bug]:  Mistral: replayed `reasoning_content` is dropped instead of being sent as a `thinking` chunk; Mistral's docs say to always replay it
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix(mistral): replay assistant reasoning as a Mistral thinking chunk. Target files: litellm/llms/mistral/chat/transformation.py, litellm/types/llms/mistral.py, litellm/model_prices_and_context_window_backup.json. When a client sent an earlier Mistral reply back, LiteLLM dropped its reasoning, so the model lost its earlier thinking (Ref: https://github.com/BerriAI/litellm/pull/48778)

workarounds.symptom: [Bug]: jev_classifier_config.api_key does not resolve os.environ/ references
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix(router)!: resolve trusted JEV connection environment references. Target files: litellm/proxy/management_endpoints/auto_router_endpoints.py, litellm/proxy/management_endpoints/model_management_endpoints.py, litellm/proxy/management_helpers/auto_router_permissions.py. JEV auto routers now resolve environment-backed credentials and URLs instead of silently falling back to heuristic routing New connection references require proxy-admin privileges, while authorized saved-router previews and unrelated edits keep working (Ref: https://github.com/BerriAI/litellm/pull/48717)

workarounds.symptom: [Bug]: BaseModelResponseIterator falsely terminates stream when tool-call arguments contain "[DONE]"
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix(streaming): exact-match the SSE [DONE] marker in BaseModelResponseIterator. Target files: litellm/llms/base_llm/base_model_iterator.py, tests/unit/llms/base_llm/test_base_model_iterator.py. The proxy treated any streamed chunk containing the text [DONE] as the end of the stream, so that chunk was thrown away. A streamed tool call whose arguments include [DONE] vanished on chat completions, the Responses API and the messages endpoint, and the client got a plain stop instead, which agent loops read as an empty final answe... (Ref: https://github.com/BerriAI/litellm/pull/47832)

workarounds.symptom: [Bug]: /v1/messages/count_tokens returns 500 for a `search_result` block, and for any content block type the local counter does not list
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix(anthropic): count search results and reject unsupported token-count blocks. Target files: litellm/litellm_core_utils/token_counter.py, litellm/proxy/anthropic_endpoints/endpoints.py, litellm/types/llms/anthropic.py. Counting tokens for Anthropic search results now works on locally counted models, including search results inside tool results. Unsupported content blocks return a useful 400 error instead of a 500, while other counting failures keep their existing behavior (Ref: https://github.com/BerriAI/litellm/pull/48699)

workarounds.symptom: [Bug]: Cohere chat sends a string stop as a string stop_sequences, the API expects a list
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix(cohere): map string stop parameter to list of strings for stop_sequences. Target files: litellm/llms/cohere/chat/transformation.py, litellm/llms/cohere/chat/v2_transformation.py, tests/unit/llms/cohere/chat/test_cohere_transformation.py. : Cohere chat API reference documents `stop_sequences` as a list of up to 5 strings (`stop_sequences: List[str]`). (Ref: https://github.com/BerriAI/litellm/pull/47091)

workarounds.symptom: [Bug]: Responses stream returns dict part when logprobs is omitted, breaking event.part.text
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix(responses): preserve typed parts when logprobs is omitted. Target files: litellm/types/llms/openai.py, tests/unit/llms/openai/responses/test_openai_responses_http.py, tests/unit/types/llms/test_types_llms_openai.py. Responses streaming now preserves typed text parts when a provider omits optional logprobs, so applications can read `event.part.text` without an AttributeError. Explicit null, empty lists, and populated values retain their behavior (Ref: https://github.com/BerriAI/litellm/pull/48686)

workarounds.symptom: [Bug]: MCP REST OpenAPI loader rejects YAML documents
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix(mcp): accept YAML OpenAPI documents. Target files: litellm/proxy/mcp_server/openapi_to_mcp_generator.py, tests/unit/proxy/mcp_server/test_mcp_server_manager.py, tests/unit/proxy/mcp_server/test_openapi_spec_path_url.py. YAML OpenAPI specs now generate MCP tools from URLs and local files. JSON keeps its existing decoding behavior, and both formats use the same loader for preview, registration, and health checks (Ref: https://github.com/BerriAI/litellm/pull/48622)

workarounds.symptom: [Feature]: Accept images on /v1/systemone and /v1/decisions for hosted_vllm decision models
workarounds.workaround: Fix: feat(hosted_vllm): accept images on decision deployments. Target files: litellm/llms/hosted_vllm/decisions/transformation.py, tests/unit/decisions/test_main.py. hosted_vllm decision deployments now accept images on /v1/decisions and /v1/systemone and pass them to vLLM's /v1/systemone `images` field, the same way LM Studio deployments already do. Before this, the gateway refused any image with a 400 before calling vLLM, even though current vLLM accepts images there. Remote https image URLs are inlined as data URLs before sen... (Ref: https://github.com/BerriAI/litellm/pull/48621)

workarounds.symptom: [Bug]: Databricks decisions route ignores OAuth M2M credentials and returns 401 "Missing API key"
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix(databricks): reuse base OAuth for decisions (#48395). Target files: litellm/llms/databricks/agent/transformation.py, litellm/llms/databricks/common_utils.py, litellm/llms/databricks/decisions/transformation.py. Databricks decisions requests return 401 when you configure OAuth M2M credentials without a static API key. Decisions now delegates token exchange and caching to DatabricksBase, which also owns the cache used by the agent route. Configured static keys keep their precedence, and tokens refresh 60 seconds before ex... (Ref: https://github.com/BerriAI/litellm/pull/48527)

workarounds.symptom: [Feature]: Support LM Studio decision models through the Decisions API
workarounds.workaround: Fix: feat(decisions): support LM Studio decision models. Target files: litellm/__init__.py, litellm/_lazy_imports_registry.py, litellm/llms/lm_studio/decisions/transformation.py. LM Studio decision models can now use the same LiteLLM Decisions routes and SDK calls as other decision providers. Requests go to LM Studio's native System One endpoint, with typed question and response translation handled by the shared Decisions pipeline (Ref: https://github.com/BerriAI/litellm/pull/48448)

workarounds.symptom: Non-object JSON request body (e.g. [], 123) returns 500 instead of 400 (AttributeError: 'list' object has no attribute 'get' in pre_db_read_auth_checks)
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix(proxy): validate JSON object bodies before request handling. Target files: litellm/proxy/auth/auth_exception_handler.py, litellm/proxy/common_utils/http_parsing_utils.py, tests/unit/proxy/auth/test_auth_exception_handler.py. Object-only API requests now return a clear 400 for nonobject JSON instead of crashing request parsing or auth error handling. Optional body defaults, protobuf handling and existing pass-through behavior are preserved (Ref: https://github.com/BerriAI/litellm/pull/48438)

workarounds.symptom: [Bug]: Can't log in to MCP toolset URLs from Claude Code or Codex
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix(mcp): advertise valid OAuth resources for toolset URLs. Target files: litellm/proxy/_experimental/mcp_server/auth/user_api_key_auth_mcp.py, litellm/proxy/proxy_server.py, tests/integration/mcp/test_mcp_oauth_flows.py. Codex and Claude Code can now sign in to MCP toolset URLs. The gateway preserves the public toolset path and advertises its existing origin-level OAuth metadata, so clients accept the resource and complete the normal MCP-session login (Ref: https://github.com/BerriAI/litellm/pull/48474)

workarounds.symptom: litellm v1.106.4: **Deployment:** Fixed the proxy sometimes exiting on startup with an `ImportError` when it cannot reach the remote model cost map, broken since v1.104.0 (#46711) <sup>Also in [1.10
workarounds.workaround: Fix: **Deployment:** Fixed the proxy sometimes exiting on startup with an `ImportError` when it cannot reach the remote model cost map, broken since v1.104.0 (#46711) <sup>Also in [1.104.7](https://github.com/BerriAI/litellm/releases/tag/v1.104.7), [1.105.5](https://github.com/BerriAI/litellm/releases/tag/v1.105.5)</sup>. workarounds.symptom: [Bug]: Groq rejects the next turn after a streamed reasoning reply because reasoning_content is sent back
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix(groq): replay streamed reasoning replies without HTTP 400 (#47931). Target files: litellm/llms/groq/chat/transformation.py, tests/unit/llms/groq/chat/test_groq_chat_transformation.py. Apps can reuse a streamed Groq reply as conversation history without getting HTTP 400 on the next turn. Reuse the existing message cleanup helper to remove response-only reasoning from outgoing history while keeping reasoning in returned replies (Ref: https://github.com/BerriAI/litellm/pull/48268)

workarounds.symptom: [Bug]: Gemini models can't be accessed through SDK
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix(llms): join api_base and route with one shared helper. Target files: litellm/litellm_core_utils/url_utils.py, litellm/llms/aiml/image_generation/transformation.py, litellm/llms/aiohttp_openai/chat/transformation.py. An `api_base` that ends in `/` makes most provider URL builders put `//` in the request path, and a gateway that keeps `//` (a default-config Envoy, or Mistral's own API) answers 404. This adds `join_api_base` and `ensure_api_route` to `url_utils` and moves every builder that joins a caller-set `api_base` on... (Ref: https://github.com/BerriAI/litellm/pull/47535)

workarounds.symptom: [Bug]: Request Failed Error Code: 500 Message: litellm.APIConnectionError: APIConnectionError: Hosted_vllmException -

Problem this solves: (Ref: https://github.com/BerriAI/litellm/pull/47198)

workarounds.symptom: [Bug]: Router fallback between vertex_ai and gemini replays endpoint-bound thought signatures -> 400 "Corrupted thought signature" (Gemini 3.x)

workarounds.symptom: [Bug]: Team doesn't exist in db. Team=litellm-dashboard
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix(auth): skip guaranteed-miss team lookup for the litellm-dashboard sentinel. Target files: litellm/proxy/auth/user_api_key_auth.py, tests/test_litellm/proxy/auth/test_user_api_key_auth.py. Problem this solves: (Ref: https://github.com/BerriAI/litellm/pull/38471)

workarounds.symptom: [Bug]: Xiaomi MiMo models: 'output_config' parameter causes AsyncCompletions.create() to fail with Claude Code
